normal.text: Seems that I now have a portable Doomsday-… um… Doom-Device. It's not as if every other device I own already has a port of Doom, after all. But another one won't hurt :D This is a pretty cool collection. Doom 1 + 2, Sigil 1 + 2 (the two episodes John Romero himself made recently for free), Evilution, Plutonia and some more. Similar to the "Doom + Doom II" collection on PC and Consoles. #retrocomputing #retrogaming #doom #evercade #videogames #videogaming #firstpersonshooter
